name: the Real Orto Botanico
title: Ancient Trees in Naples' Botanical Garden: 5 Giants
meta_description: Founded by Napoleonic decree in 1807. Five remarkable trees, including the widest trunk on Naples' whole register and a palm nearly drunk out of existence.
intro: Founded by Napoleonic decree in 1807 and planted with things Naples had never seen, which is why four of these five trees come from other continents. The widest trunk on Naples' entire national register stands here, a silk floss tree whose bulging green trunk looks less like timber than like something inflated. Beside it grows a Chilean wine palm, a species nearly drunk out of existence because its trunk is full of sweet sap that was tapped for wine. The exception is the ginkgo, which is not a novelty from far away but a survivor from far back.
